mapper.select: SELECT s.*, w.name AS workspace_name, wm.role AS member_role FROM shops s JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=s.workspace_id JOIN workspace_memberships wm ON wm.workspace_id=w.id JOIN app_users u ON u.id=wm.user_id WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.enabled=TRUE AND wm.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY s.id

SELECT u.id,u.username,(u.enabled AND wm.enabled) AS enabled,wm.enabled AS membership_enabled,wm.role,wm.revision FROM workspace_memberships wm JOIN app_users u ON u.id=wm.user_id WHERE wm.workspace_id=#{workspace} ORDER BY wm.created_at,u.username
SELECT id FROM workspaces WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT user_id FROM workspace_memberships WHERE user_id=#{user} AND workspace_id=#{workspace}
mapper.update: UPDATE workspaces SET owner_user_id=#{user} WHERE id=#{workspace} AND owner_user_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shops WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shops WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace}
SELECT id,name,owner_user_id FROM workspaces WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,created_by,created_at,expires_at,consumed_at,revoked FROM workspace_invitations WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE shops SET name=#{name} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE workspace_invitations SET revoked=TRUE WHERE id=#{id} AND workspace_id=#{workspace}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workspace_invitations WHERE token_hash=#{hash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_invitations SET consumed_at=#{timestamp} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM shops WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT shop_id FROM connector_bindings WHERE platform_shop_id=#{platform} AND shop_id<>#{shop}
